page.purpose: Every thread across every channel in one list, with one thread open beside it. This page is also the in-app conversation surface, which is an ordinary channel adapter rather than a special case, so it must not offer any affordance an external channel cannot have.

claims.statement: Every thread row carries its channel identity, so the channel is known before the message is read.
claims.rationale: Priority one. A mixed-channel list where the channel is only in the detail pane forces a click to answer the first question.

claims.statement: An agent-authored message is perceivably distinct from a human-authored one without relying on colour alone.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-004 makes authorship load-bearing; a person must be able to see what the loop breaker sees.

claims.statement: A refusal states what was withheld and what would unblock it, rather than failing silently or answering partially.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-002 forbids the partial answer, so the refusal itself has to carry the information.

claims.statement: When speaking discipline suppresses a turn, the surface says the agent is not answering here rather than appearing broken.
claims.rationale: OT-P1-003 makes silence correct behaviour, which means silence must be legible or it reads as a defect.

claims.statement: A disabled composer always states why it is disabled and what would re-enable it.
A failed send preserves the drafted text in the composer.
The send action prevents duplicate submission while a send is in flight.
The transcript exposes a log role so a screen reader announces arriving messages without moving focus.
On opening a thread the newest message is visible without scrolling.
Remaining turn budget is shown in the thread only when it is close to exhausted, not at all times.
claims.rationale: A meter that is always present becomes furniture and stops being read.

claims.statement: A thread with more than one human shows its roster, because the room's ceiling derives from it.
The empty state offers the single action that creates a first thread.
The in-app thread offers no affordance that an external channel adapter cannot also provide.
claims.rationale: OT-P0-014. If the console can do something Telegram cannot, the core has grown a special case.

claims.statement: Answering or dismissing the capability gate returns focus to the composer.
Authorship, refusal and offline treatments hold their distinction in both themes.
